record.question: Saad Hariri stepped down from President of which country?
record.explanation: Answer D: None of these. Saad Hariri resigned as Lebanon’s Prime Minister in October 2019. He was not the President. Because the printed question says “President” and offers “None of these,” option (d) is the literal answer; an editorial correction to “Prime Minister” would make Lebanon the answer instead. Reference: https://www.britannica.com/biography/Saad-al-Hariri. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical facts are anchored to the original exam; no matching examiner key is asserted.
